name: Shorthand
tagline: Shorthand is a visual storytelling platform for creating immersive, scroll-based digital stories without coding. Journalists, marketing teams, and brand communicators use it to publish long-form stories that combine text, video, parallax imagery, and data visualizations in a format designed for screen reading. It is used by major news organizations and brands to produce editorial-quality content that performs better than static articles.
